mapper.select: SELECT rig.id, rig.student_id, rig.goal_id, rig.created_at, rig.updated_at FROM report_item_groups rig JOIN goals g ON g.id = rig.goal_id WHERE rig.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY g.start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_item_groups (id, student_id, goal_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{goalId})
